_doc: Access rows for regional_survivor_hunters. ROWS, NEVER CODE. terms: UNREAD (default; fetched under robots.txt and the hard stops, and the read is owed) | NO_BAR (read; nothing forbids automated or commercial use) | FORBIDS (fail-closed: never fetched). auth: LOGIN_REQUIRED means the listing is behind a login and is never fetched. Each value carries the evidence and date it was read. Governance ruling 2026-11-10.
